text: Forteasia Industrial Township, Rohtak. Ek sau adtees acre. Kaam zameen par chal raha hai. Industrial plots, paanch sau se chaar hazaar square yard. Trucks ke liye chaudi roads. NH-152D sirf das minute. Aur project, HRERA registered.
